styleHardLock.visualStyle: 1970s Thai-Chinese historical comedy film aesthetic, vertical 9:16. Faded Eastmancolor, warm sepia cast, soft period lens, visible film grain, slight gate weave, tiny scratches, muted contrast, dusty practical sets, natural sunlight. No modern objects, no fantasy glow, no polished idol styling.
